evidence: Beginning at the restored Motukarara Railway Station, the trail follows the line of the old railway through open paddocks.
After this there's a short on road section just before Little River.
The township of Little River offers a craft and information centre, pub, cafe, gallery and accommodation.

ways.label: Christchurch (Hornby) to Motukarara section

via.name: Lincoln
via.quote: The section between Prebbleton and Lincoln

evidence: This 26 km section is not maintained by DOC.
The Hornby (Christchurch) to Prebbleton section (3.5k m) is an off-road track that runs alongside Shands Rd and Marshes Rd.
The section between Lincoln and Neills Rd (9.3 km) is still under development but follows Edward St, Ellesmere Rd and River Rd.
Neills Rd to Motukarara (6 km) is an off-road track that mostly runs adjacent to the Halswell Canal.

doubts: The page title covers Christchurch to Little River, but DOC's '20 km one way' fits the section DOC maintains (Motukarara to Little River), so that is the main way (W1). Its time is not given (the packet time is empty), and its distance is DOC's summary figure rather than a figure in the text. The Christchurch (Hornby) to Motukarara section (W2) is a separate way because it has its own heading and a 26 km distance; the page says it is not maintained by DOC. W1 start is the Motukarara Railway Station (ref T7, the place Motukarara). No feature matches Fiddlers Road, so no road end is used. W1 end is Little River (T6); the text does not say where on the Christchurch to Akaroa road the trail ends, so no road end feature (F9 or others) is used. The text does not say whether the trail returns the same way. The Birdlings Flat detour's leaving point is not stated, so side trip from is null. Hornby has no feature entry, so the W2 start ref is null.
